Push notification.summary: Send a high-priority asset alert to one user

schema.description: Notification submission containing a typed message, one or more targets, and optional repeat scheduling.

message.description: Typed notification message; its discriminator selects email, push, or another installed message subtype.
message.title: AbstractNotificationMessage

name.description: Optional human-readable notification name used in delivery records.

repeatFrequency.description: Optional repeat cadence for scheduled delivery.

repeatInterval.description: Repeat interval expression interpreted with repeatFrequency.

targets.description: One or more recipients. Authorization is checked for the complete set before anything is queued.

items.description: Delivery target. The target type determines whether id refers to a user, asset, realm, or custom address.
items.title: Target

schema.title: Notification

body.description: Message, source, and one or more delivery targets to queue.
